intro: Which council looks after what in Harvington, Norton and Lenchwick, where the parish councils meet, and how to see or comment on planning applications.
meetingsNote: See sites/lenches/_data/council.json. Harvington PC: second Wednesday except August (its 2026-27 dates in the April 2026 minutes; 18 Nov 2026). Norton and Lenchwick: no rule yet.

parishes.name: Harvington Parish Council
parishes.meets: Meets on the second Wednesday of every month except August, at 7.45pm in Harvington Village Hall. Members of the public are welcome to attend.

parishes.name: Norton and Lenchwick Parish Council
parishes.meets: Meeting dates, agendas and minutes are published on the council's website.

roles.title: Parish council
roles.text: Gives its view on planning applications and looks after village matters such as open spaces and noticeboards.

roles.title: Wychavon District
roles.text: Decides planning applications and runs bin collections, council tax, housing and licensing.

roles.title: Worcestershire County
roles.text: Roads and pavements, potholes, streetlights, public footpaths, schools, libraries and social care.

planning.text: Wychavon decides planning applications, and you can look them up and comment on its website. Each parish council is asked for its view on applications in its own area.
